title: Reflection angles table
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 2 (Reflection angles table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 2: Reflection: how mirrors bounce light. To understand how light reflects off surfaces and how mirrors reflect it in a predictable way

questions.q: A ray hits at 55° to the normal. What is the angle of reflection?
questions.model: Angle in equals angle out. In is 55°. So out is 55°.

questions.q: Why can you see yourself in a spoon but not in a towel?
questions.a: The spoon is smooth and shiny; the towel scatters light

questions.q: How do we see a book that is not a light source?
questions.a: Light reflects off it into our eyes

questions.q: Use a torch, a mirror and a protractor on paper. Shine at 20°, 40° and 60° to the normal and measure the reflected angle. Record in a table.
questions.model: Teacher draws the mirror line and the normal on camera and shines the first ray at 20°.

questions.q: Why might your measurements be a few degrees out?
questions.a: The beam is wide and hard to line up exactly

questions.q: Draw how a mirror at a corner could send a beam round it.
questions.a: Mirror at 45°, ray in, ray out at a right angle

questions.q: Angle of reflection equals angle of...
Big question: how could you send a beam round a corner?
questions.a: Angle a mirror so the light reflects in the new direction (45° turns it through a right angle).
